failed_or_abandoned: Normalising the inventory primarily on 127Xe + 125Xe = 1.5 was abandoned (the single-scatter ROI acceptance of 127Xe needs gamma-escape geometry, x3 uncertain); kept as a cross-check that fixes the Table-I-anchored intermediate capture set (implied 127Xe/125Xe production ratio 0.22 between thermal 0.02 and fast 0.75).
Keeping 137Cs in the xenon for the whole 220 d made it the leading correlated channel (x6); demoted to an upper bracket because Cs, like I, is removed by purification.
